arxiv-1908-07343.title: The Role of Vacuum Fluctuations and Symmetry in the Hydrogen Atom in Quantum Mechanics and SED
arxiv-1908-07343.creator: G. Jordan Maclay
arxiv-1908-07343.description: Abstract SED has had success modeling black body radiation, the harmonic oscillator, the Casimir effect, van der Waals forces, diamagnetism, and uniform acceleration of electrodynamic systems using the stochastic zero-point fluctuations of the electromagnetic field with classical mechanics. However the hydrogen atom, with its 1/r potential remains a critical challenge.

arxiv-2203-06792.title: Robust 2-D DOA Estimation in a Polarization Sensitive Single User Environment
arxiv-2203-06792.creator: Md Imrul Hasan, Mohammad Saquib
arxiv-2203-06792.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Md Imrul Hasan, Mohammad Saquib. Apart from the conventional parameters (such as signal-to-noise ratio, array geometry and size, sample size), several other factors (e.g. alignment of the antenna elements, polarization parameters) influence the performance of direction of arrival (DOA) estimating algorithms. When all the antenna elements are identically aligned, the polarization parameters do not affect the steering vectors, which is the underlying assumption of all the conventional DOA algorithms.

arxiv-2305-14147.title: Improved Measurements of Nonlinear Integrable Optics at IOTA
arxiv-2305-14147.creator: J. N. Wieland, A. L. Romanov, A. Valishev. G. Stancari, J. D. Jarvis, Fermilab, Batavia, IL, USA N. Kuklev, ANL, Lemont, IL, USA S. Szustkowski, LANL, Los Alamos, NM, USA S. Nagaitsev, JLAB, Newport News, VA, USA
arxiv-2305-14147.description: Abstract Nonlinear integrable optics (NIO) are a promising novel approach at improving the stability of high intensity beams. Implementations of NIO based on specialized magnetic elements are being tested at the Integrable Optics Test Accelerator (IOTA) at Fermilab. One method of verifying proper implementation of these solutions is by measuring the analytic invariants predicted by theory.

arxiv-2306-04237.title: Randomized 3D Scene Generation for Generalizable Self-Supervised Pre-Training
arxiv-2306-04237.creator: Lanxiao Li, Michael Heizmann, michael.heizmann@kit.edu
arxiv-2306-04237.description: Abstract Capturing and labeling real-world 3D data is laborious and time-consuming, which makes it costly to train strong 3D models. To address this issue, recent works present a simple method by generating randomized 3D scenes without simulation and rendering. Although models pre-trained on the generated synthetic data gain impressive performance boosts, previous works have two major shortcomings.

arxiv-2404-14130.title: X-shooter spectroscopy of Liller 1 giant stars Thanks: Based on observations collected at the Very Large Telescope (VLT) of the European Southern Observatory at Cerro Paranal (Chile) under program 089.D-0306 (PI:Ferraro).
arxiv-2404-14130.creator: D. A. Alvarez Garay ,, C. Fanelli, L. Origlia, C. Pallanca ,, A. Mucciarelli ,, L. Chiappino ,, C. Crociati ,, B. Lanzoni ,, F. R. Ferraro ,, R. M. Rich, and E. Dalessandro
arxiv-2404-14130.description: Abstract We present the first comprehensive chemical study of a representative sample of 27 luminous red giant branch (RGB) stars belonging to Liller 1, a complex stellar system in the Galactic bulge. This study is based on medium-resolution near-infrared spectra acquired with X-shooter at the Very Large Telescope.

arxiv-2503-17177.title: Isoperimetric bubbles in spaces with density r p + a r^{p}+a
arxiv-2503-17177.creator: Martyn Gwynne, Simon Cox
arxiv-2503-17177.description: Abstract Least perimeter solutions for a region with fixed mass are sought in ℝ d {\mathbb{R}^{d}} on which a density function ρ ⁡ ( r ) = r p + a \rho(r)=r^{p}+a , with p > 0 , a > 0 p>0,a>0 , weights both perimeter and mass.

arxiv-2505-19573.title: Biorderability of knot quandles of knots up to eight crossings
arxiv-2505-19573.creator: Vaishnavi Gupta, Hitesh Raundal
arxiv-2505-19573.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Vaishnavi Gupta, Hitesh Raundal. The paper investigates biorderability of knot quandles of prime knots up to eight crossings. We prove that knot quandles of knots 6 3 \mathchar 28726_{\mathchar 28723} , 8 7 \mathchar 28728_{\mathchar 28727} , 8 8 \mathchar 28728_{\mathchar 28728} , 8 1 ​ 0 \mathchar 28728_{\mathchar 28721\mathchar 28720} and 8 1 ​ 6 \mathchar 28728_{\mathchar 28721\mathchar 28726} can not be biorderable.

arxiv-2509-18329.title: Uncut Gem - An Open-Source Hackable Quantum Sensor
arxiv-2509-18329.creator: Mark Carney, Victoria Kumaran
arxiv-2509-18329.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mark Carney, Victoria Kumaran. This work presents an overview of our fully open-source, hackable quantum sensor platform based on nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center diamond magnetometry. This initiative aims to democratize access to quantum sensing by providing a comprehensive, modular, and cost-effective system. The design leverages consumer off-the-shelf (COTS) components in a novel hardware configuration, complemented by open-source firmware written in the Arduino IDE, facilitating portability, ease of customization, and future-proofing the design.

arxiv-2510-20320.title: Strong uniqueness of tangent flows at cylindrical singularities in Ricci flow
arxiv-2510-20320.creator: Hanbing Fang, and, Yu Li
arxiv-2510-20320.description: Abstract In this paper, we establish a Lojasiewicz inequality for the pointed 𝒲 \mathcal{W} -entropy in the Ricci flow, under the assumption that the geometry near the base point is close to a standard cylinder ℝ k × S n − k \mathbb{R}^{k}\times S^{n-k} or the quotient thereof.

arxiv-2601-02035.title: Sub-Laplacian generalized curvature dimension inequalities on Riemannian foliations
arxiv-2601-02035.creator: Fabrice Baudoin , Guang Yang
arxiv-2601-02035.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Fabrice Baudoin , Guang Yang. We develop a Bochner theory and Bakry-Émery calculus for horizontal Laplacians associated with general Riemannian foliations. No bundle-like assumption on the metric, nor any total geodesicity or minimality condition on the leaves, is imposed. Using a metric connection adapted to the horizontal–vertical splitting, we derive explicit Bochner formulas for the horizontal Laplacian acting on horizontal and vertical gradients, as well as a unified identity for the full gradient.

arxiv-2601-11000.title: When Personalization Misleads: Understanding and Mitigating Hallucinations in Personalized LLMs
arxiv-2601-11000.creator: Zhongxiang Sun, Yi Zhan, Chenglei Shen, Weijie Yu, Xiao Zhang, Ming He, Jun Xu
arxiv-2601-11000.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Zhongxiang Sun, Yi Zhan, Chenglei Shen, Weijie Yu, Xiao Zhang, Ming He, Jun Xu. Personalized large language models (LLMs) adapt model behavior to individual users to enhance user satisfaction, yet personalization can inadvertently distort factual reasoning.

arxiv-2602-12529.title: Flow-Factory: A Unified Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Flow-Matching Models
arxiv-2602-12529.creator: Bowen Ping, Chengyou Jia, Minnan Luo, Hangwei Qian, Ivor Tsang
arxiv-2602-12529.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning has emerged as a promising paradigm for aligning diffusion and flow-matching models with human preferences, yet practitioners face fragmented codebases, model-specific implementations, and engineering complexity. We introduce Flow-Factory , a unified framework that decouples algorithms, models, and rewards through through a modular, registry-based architecture.

arxiv-2605-15417.title: f f -Trajectory Balance: A Loss Family for Tuning GFlowNets, Generative Models, and LLMs with Off- and On-Policy Data
arxiv-2605-15417.creator: Jake Fawkes, Jason Hartford

pmc-10726387.title: Electrical Discharge in a Cavitating Liquid under an Ultrasound Field
pmc-10726387.creator: T. Karabassov, A. S. Vasenko, V. M. Bayazitov, A. A. Golubov, I. S. Fedulov, A. V. Abramova
pmc-10726387.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). A theoretical model for an electrical discharge in a cavitating liquid is developed and compared with experiments for the optimization of the water treatment device. The calculations based on solution of the Noltingk—Neppiras equation support the hypothesis that the electric field promotes the formation of vapor microchannels inside a liquid gap between the electrodes, where at a low gas pressure Paschen’s conditions of rupture and abnormal glow discharge maintenance in those microchannels are fulfilled.

pmc-11585101.title: Radiographic and clinical evaluation of external pedicle screw fixation as a definitive solution for selective acetabular fractures: a retrospective analysis
pmc-11585101.creator: Zhen Xia, Yazhong Zhang, Xu Zhang, Wenbo Li, Yongxiang Lv, Xiangyu Qi, Yunqing Wang, Ziqiang Zhu
pmc-11585101.description: BackgroundAcetabular fractures typically require open surgery to restore hip joint function. Openness may lead to serious tissue damage, increased bleeding, and the risk of nerve and vascular damage. Minimally invasive closed reduction or percutaneous fixation aims to minimize additional harm to patients and provide reliable fixation to promote fracture recovery and functional rehabilitation.

pmc-11688411.title: Immunosuppressant nonadherence profile in kidney transplant recipients and the impact of medication adherence on transplant outcomes
pmc-11688411.creator: Zou Zhi-yu, Dai Lin-rui, Yu Chen-zhen, Chen Ren-jie, Yu Fei-hong, Chen Song, Chang Sheng, Zhang Wei-jie
pmc-11688411.description: BackgroundDespite the fact that 1-year graft and recipient survival rates are above 90% in most transplant centers, improving long-term graft survival remains an important challenge. Immunosuppressant nonadherence has been recognized as one of the important risk factors for long-term graft failure.

pmc-13281199.title: Structural Lipidomics Uncovers CC Location-Specific Lipid Signatures and the Response to Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor in dMMR/MSI‑H Colorectal Cancer
pmc-13281199.creator: Yiwei Tou, Wei Sun, Pai Liu, Jiuyi Sun, Taiyang Ma, Yun-Hong Zhang
pmc-13281199.description: Lipidomics offers valuable insights for cancer research. Paternò–Büchi (PB) reaction-based LC-MS/MS enables precise lipid structural resolution at the CC location level. Although mismatch repair-deficient or microsatellite instability-high (dMMR/MSI-H) status predicts anti-PD-1 response in colorectal cancer (CRC), nearly half of the patients do not benefit, underscoring the need for better biomarkers.

pmc-13306650.title: Sensors-Driven Multimodal Deepfake Detection: A Cross-Attention Fusion Approach with Adaptive Modality Gating
pmc-13306650.creator: Syeda Sitara Waseem, Noman Shabbir, Syed Rizwan Hassan, KangYoon Lee

pmc-13382377.title: Functional Implications of Marine Biosurfactants and Their Therapeutic Potential Against Alzheimer's Disease
pmc-13382377.creator: Zainab Irfan, Shakti Ketan Prusty, Sumon Giri, Arijit Nandi, Mostafa Gouda
pmc-13382377.description: Neuronal damage and cerebral impairment are defining characteristics of Alzheimer's disease (AD), a progressive neurodegenerative disorder associated with amyloid‐β aggregation, oxidative stress, and neuroinflammation. Current treatments mainly provide symptomatic relief and do not effectively prevent disease progression, highlighting the need for novel disease‐modifying strategies.

pmc-13415174.title: Nutritional Risk Among Emergency Department Patients with Diabetes Mellitus or Chronic Kidney Disease: A Single-Center Prospective Observational Comparative Study
pmc-13415174.creator: Sema Ayten, Emine Ünal, Michal Pruc, Iwona Niewiadomska, Lukasz Szarpak
pmc-13415174.description: Background/Objectives: Patients with diabetes mellitus (DM) and chronic kidney disease (CKD) frequently present to emergency departments (EDs) with acute metabolic or renal complications. Nutritional risk may coexist with disease severity in this population, but its relationship with hospital admission remains insufficiently characterized. This study aimed to compare the nutritional status between admitted and discharged ED patients with DM and/or CKD.

pmc-13422936.title: Implementation barriers and facilitators to a vocational rehabilitation intervention after traumatic injury (ROWTATE) in the UK: qualitative interviews with key stakeholders
pmc-13422936.creator: Claire Mann, Rebecca Lindley, Denise Kendrick, Kate Radford, Jain Holmes, Blerina Kellezi, Roshan das Nair, Fahim Anwar, Laura Graham, Nima Moghaddam, Robert Crouch, Karen Hoffman, Steve Fallon, Trevor Jones, Isobel Andrews, Ali Gibson, Stephen Timmons

pmc-13582137.title: Outcomes of transanal vs laparoscopic total mesorectal excision for mid and low rectal cancer under routine clinical practice conditions
pmc-13582137.creator: Chen Su, Junfeng Du, Yang Xie, Xiang Xu, Lanxin Hu, Xuefei Zhang, Yinggang Ge, Hongyu Zhang
pmc-13582137.description: BackgroundOncologic outcomes in mid and low rectal cancer depend critically on the quality and reproducibility of total mesorectal excision. Transanal total mesorectal excision (TaTME) has been introduced to address technical challenges in distal pelvic dissection and margin acquisition in selected patient populations. However, concerns regarding oncologic safety have been raised when TaTME is implemented outside controlled trial settings.

pmc-13673635.title: Consistent individual differences in foraging movement tactics drive habitat partitioning in an inland-breeding Great Cormorant population
pmc-13673635.creator: Bálint Preiszner, Péter Szinai, Gyula Kovács
pmc-13673635.description: BackgroundIndividual variation in animal movement and habitat selection is increasingly recognised as a structurally important component of population ecology, yet the magnitude and temporal consistency of foraging movement specialisation remain poorly characterised in inland-breeding waterbirds. Inland populations of Great Cormorants (Phalacrocorax carbo sinensis) exploit a mosaic of freshwater habitat types in anthropogenic landscapes and generate recurrent conflict with fisheries.

uslaw-cfr-t10-s490-304.title: 10 C.F.R. § 490.304 — Which new light duty motor vehicles are covered.
uslaw-cfr-t10-s490-304.creator: Department Of Energy
uslaw-cfr-t10-s490-304.description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 10 (Energy), Part 490 (Alternative Fuel Transportation Program). uslaw-usc-t18-s1033.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s1033.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part I (Crimes); Chapter 47 (Fraud And False Statements). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) (1) Whoever is engaged in the business of insurance whose activities affect interstate commerce and knowingly, with the intent to deceive, makes any false material statement or report or willfully and materially overvalues any land, property or security—.
